addQuestionCandidates.concept: TestFlight for distributing and testing iOS builds
addQuestionCandidates.reason: No direct current interview-catalog question found. Recurs in DOU 250+, DOU 400+ and current international mobile-QA interview material.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical canonical question about what TestFlight is, how a QA uses it, build/version/device access and feedback/crash workflow. Do not split into command/tool trivia.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Mobile HTTP/HTTPS traffic interception and proxy debugging
addQuestionCandidates.reason: No direct interview-catalog question found. Recurs in DOU 250+, DOU 400+ and current international mobile interview material; GimmeJob currently has the topic only in testing-tools learning content.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One Middle-level practical question covering proxy setup, device trust/certificates, request/response inspection and HTTPS interception limitations. Use OWASP MASTG later only to validate the answer.

addQuestionCandidates.reason: DOU 250+ contains baseline Git questions; DOU 400+ adds conflicts, pull vs fetch and cherry-pick; a current 2026 QA/SDET-specific interview source emphasizes daily workflow, branching, merge conflicts, undo/review and CI integration. No direct authored Git interview question was found in common-qa, canonical-baseline or modern-sdet authored sets.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: Prefer one practical workflow question over separate trivia for clone/pull/fetch/cherry-pick. A strong answer should explain branch -> change -> commit -> sync/rebase-or-merge -> conflict handling -> PR -> CI, with safe handling of shared history.
